findings.requestedFix: Move A and H labels away from the vertical line without moving any geometric point or reducing font size.
findings.status: resolved; final initial/last screenshots rechecked at widths 320 and 1280

Alternative layouts and counterexamples are not superimposed in the reviewed initial/last scenes.
The line, angle and square-grid drawings remain visually distinct by task.

verdict: passed for the explicitly listed final manual visual scope; no unresolved findings
